test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Fitter) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should be replaced by # and % so that the pattern and relation followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: sign is the same as the pattern and relation followed between the letter-cluster pair on the right side of :: sign?

# : EAG :: IEK : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

The pattern is a backward shift of -1 for each letter.

# : EAG :: IEK : %

**Option 1) # = FBH, % = HDI**

**For # (FBH) to EAG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e16743f24243beb31f7065bee53e9e14c57115b841590906d37e4e944886c3f8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/367f4ef80c54694b361f42f5744dd42295bf108163cd501d9e052eb71a6e5a3c.png] 

The pattern from FBH to EAG is: (-1, -1, -1).

**For IEK to % (HDI)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62df52e27948c76003e78dc1044fc6564e8243f9c972e594cba2b7ed0a8ed3e2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c383e4cf82aec11ca5c9da1dbc4de693cbd54b96945aa3fc13c5805d2813d7b.png] 

The pattern from IEK to HDI is: (-1, -1, -2).

**Option 1** is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = FBH, % = HDJ**

**For # (FBH) to EAG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bf1ebfc6615e90f54d35a868fb30c51937f2f4a7df9dcba9c9bb740255c0127.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed1b0d6ab296a93463de6e8664fd93b5b021fd6ee6275acc64506e270395b878.png] 

The pattern from FBH to EAG is: (-1, -1, -1).

**For IEK to % (HDJ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/528ed7c6ae3d60ea346f3fe120efa1eb599abb56dac9f56c351b5cf2fa61d116.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6047a99a35db7e65d1d684bff097889f8a4054db8a36c208e98bfc48d35697e0.png] 

The pattern from IEK to HDJ is: (-1, -1, -1).

**Option 2** is the correct answer.

**Option 3) # = FBG, % = HDJ**

**For # (FBG) to EAG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/736b48d153c2a4117923599c01697bdb16a8484eb6f67b04dcf7f903f5f118d9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9e1abaf3b5fd519b3da19f21339424527607ada5dfd8bd1efe631e16f8d332.png] 

 

The pattern from FBG to EAG is: (-1, -1, +0).

**For IEK to % (HDJ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae13c4515e042ce6edb3508fdb63af0212902a339f60a870f0b8e2c580636ba7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92cc793b04baeace439e95ff2d42468e4da6edaa0e948817acda2f04076d1b84.png] 

The pattern from IEK to HDJ is: (-1, -1, -1).

**Option 3** is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = FBH, % = HEJ**

**For # (FBH) to EAG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8be6a5824a182f6cbbf5943590db6f721990d3e662098b24cbc8d75573052231.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/367f4ef80c54694b361f42f5744dd42295bf108163cd501d9e052eb71a6e5a3c.png] 

The pattern from FBH to EAG is: (-1, -1, -1).

**For IEK to % (HEJ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4315fef4678ae07cf476888b0a63f3972b6ceaba4c65239cfd61f8440010d4a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63580ea5e0be236f0e327d59ecd0e233dc2cfc507be2bffb9a73af26af7fafb1.png] 

The pattern from IEK to HEJ is: (-1, +0, -1).

**Option 4** is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
